approvals.reason: Radio items take an `indicator` option: 'check' (default) draws a trailing check, macOS-menu style, with the slot reserved on every row so widths do not shift with selection; 'none' lets rich multi-line items such as SandboxPicker place their own check on the title row.
Radix wraps scroll content in a display:table element that sizes to its widest child and defeats text truncation; forcing it to block keeps content at the viewport width.

The mobile Sheet path returns before desktop sidebar markup renders, so the stock responsive display gates are redundant; removing them prevents Electron's generated responsive CSS from hiding the desktop sidebar. The fixed container takes the shell's --app-height and pads for the bottom safe area, the iOS standalone viewport recipe the rest of the shell uses, and SIDEBAR_WIDTH is exported for the shell's width variable.
The host passes its light/dark mode as the `theme` prop (the desktop maps its persisted named theme), instead of the stock next-themes hook; no visual drift or second theme authority.
Tooltips use the semantic popover surface with a border and shadow, and omit the malformed rotated Radix arrow so the shared component remains opaque and legible across themes.
